evidence.paraphrase: Autoencoded KV-cache entries; Anchor frames. Ongoing generation is conditioned on the cached anchors (read internally during decoding).

During operation, Memorize-and-Generate applies a trained but frozen update module to Structural anchors (final frame of each attention block) for long-term consistency; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

During operation, Memorize-and-Generate applies merging or deduplication of overlapping entries to Structural anchors (final frame of each attention block) for long-term consistency; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

KV-cache entries are maintained, compressed, and evicted by a fixed learned mechanism as the stream proceeds. For Memorize-and-Generate, this specifically supports explicit deletion or eviction of stored items of Structural anchors (final frame of each attention block) for long-term consistency.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 7): During inference, the operative memory component (Structural anchors (final frame of each attention block) for long-term consistency) changes through a trained but frozen update module, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
